_readme: Settings for provisioning/dataverse/ensure-schema.ps1 ONLY — deliberately NOT named
dev-settings.json. Get-ProvisioningSettings -Env dev must keep throwing 'file not
found', because several other scripts and their tests (verify-role-bindings.ps1,
deliberately rely on that exception as the signal that DEV has no group-team bindings,
auditing config or Setting rows scripted against it in Phase 1 (see each script's own
-Env dev handling). ensure-schema.ps1 reads THIS file directly instead, bypassing
Get-ProvisioningSettings entirely, so that invariant is undisturbed.
NEW 2026-08-14 — see provisioning/dataverse/ensure-schema.ps1's own header for why it
exists: Entities/Attributes/OptionSets/Roles/Field Security Profiles are documented by
Microsoft as UNSUPPORTED to create from scratch via solution import, so the entire
Phase 1 schema is instead created once in DEV via the Dataverse Web API, and Power
Platform Pipelines (ADR-007) promotes it to TST/ACC and PRD from there.
Identifiers only — never a secret, token or connection string (C-TECH-001). The
provisioning app id and certificate thumbprint stay in the environment variables
